facts.what: 尸体倒地、金发女仍在旁，她承认自己没跑
承认用石头结束循环、也救 Blair；自问是否有暴力本能
facts.anchor: Have I always had such violence in me?

facts.what: 确认他已死，说「我们没事」
facts.anchor: I mean, he is dead – but that’s OK. We’re OK, Cassie.

facts.what: 把玫瑰石英抱到水槽冲洗，怕石头吸他的血
facts.anchor: I can’t let the stone absorb his blood.

facts.what: 提议烧车毁尸；Cassie 反驳他不是一封信
facts.anchor: we could actually burn his body

facts.what: 计划用他的手机给他妈发消息：他去旅行寻己/交了新欢
facts.anchor: I’ll send her a message from his phone.

facts.what: 把手机丢克莱德河、与 Blair 结盟一起收尾
facts.anchor: ‘Let’s do it. But you’re not doing it by yourself. I’m coming with you. We will finish this together.’

relations: Cassie 与 Blair 成为共犯；决定处理尸体并离开
